meta.name: hyperframes-cli
meta.description: Use the HyperFrames CLI development loop: init, add, catalog, capture, lint, check, snapshot, compare, grade-compare, preview, play, present, beats, keyframes, single or batch render, publish, cloud, cloudrun, feedback, lambda, doctor, browser, info, upgrade, skills, compositions, docs, benchmark, telemetry, transcribe, auth, tts, and remove-background. Also use when diagnosing build or render failures. validate, inspect, and layout are deprecated aliases; use check. Covers local, HeyGen-hosted cloud, AWS Lambda, and Google Cloud Run rendering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过命令行完成视频渲染、预览和部署
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在本地或云端命令行渲染视频
copy.tagline_en: Render, preview, and deploy videos from the command line
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to render videos locally or in the cloud via CLI

howto.what: 装上这技能后，Claude会通过HyperFrames命令行工具创建、检查、预览和渲染视频项目；它能在本地或云端（HeyGen、AWS、Google）执行初始化、预览、渲染等步骤，并用检查命令找出构建或渲染问题。
howto.when: 当用户要求制作或修改HyperFrames视频项目，或需要诊断构建/渲染失败时触发。

say.text: 帮我用HyperFrames初始化一个新视频项目
say.note: 会运行init命令创建项目骨架。

say.text: 运行hyperframes check检查我的项目
say.note: 会执行检查并返回是否有错误。
会调用cloud render进行托管渲染。

howto.what_en: Enables Claude to drive the HyperFrames CLI workflow: scaffold, edit, lint, check, preview, and render video projects locally or on cloud platforms such as HeyGen, AWS Lambda, and Google Cloud Run, and diagnose build/render failures.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to create or modify a HyperFrames video project, or when diagnosing build or render failures.

say_en.text: Initialize a new HyperFrames video project for me.
say_en.note: Runs init to scaffold the project.

say_en.text: Run hyperframes check on my project.
say_en.note: Executes the final gate including lint.

say_en.text: Render my video using the cloud.
say_en.note: Uses cloud render for hosted rendering.
